name: Quick Retreat
body:
You can retract into your shell very quickly.

Prerequisite: Zif, Flee to Shelter, character level 7

Benefit: You may retract into your shell in place of a 5-foot step, rather than using a move or standard action. You may leave your shell as a move action.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
